name: ALFWorld (Harbor)
summary: Play text-only ALFWorld household episodes through an alfworld command line in a sandbox, reaching the goal within 50 actions.

reward.note: A fresh verifier replays the submitted commands and awards 1 for a simulator win within 50 actions, 0 otherwise.

run:
uvx harbor==0.26.0 run \
  --repo https://huggingface.co/datasets/emrekuruu/alfworld-harbor@v2.0.0 \
  -d alfworld-development@2.0.0 -i alfworld-development-0191 -a oracle
needs: Docker, Linux x86-64
validated: An oracle uses upstream walkthroughs or TextWorld's planner to solve tasks; the upstream games are public.

name: ScienceWorld (Harbor)
summary: Complete ScienceWorld elementary-science tasks with a command line to the simulator within 49 submitted commands.

reward.note: A fresh simulator replays the actions and returns the best simulator score divided by 100, clipped to [0, 1].

run:
uvx harbor==0.26.0 run \
  --repo https://huggingface.co/datasets/emrekuruu/scienceworld-harbor@v1.0.0 \
  -d scienceworld-development@1.0.0 -i scienceworld-development-0001 -a oracle
needs: Docker
validated: Some simulator reference sequences do not reach 100 within the 49-command limit, so the oracle submits the usable prefix.

name: Recursive-Play Bench
summary: Solve 150 executable puzzle environments of six sequential levels each within 512 actions and 720 seconds.
good_for: hard puzzle tasks no model has finished

reward.note: Scored by six-level wins and cleared levels (out of 900 offered); partial progress is credited.

validated: Challenges are witness-solvable; fifteen tasks had no complete six-level win from any of eleven evaluated configurations.

name: Data Agent Harbor (eval)
summary: Answer a question about a real Kaggle dataset by exploring the input files in a sandbox and writing the answer to a file.

reward.note: grader.py compares /workdir/answer.txt by exact, numeric tolerance, list or percent normalisation, then symbolic match, scoring 1.0 or 0.0.

run:
openenv harbor info --dataset HuggingEnvs/data-agent-harbor-eval
openenv harbor run  --dataset HuggingEnvs/data-agent-harbor-eval --model <your-model>
validated: Every task was verified by a strong agent reproducing the gold answer under deterministic grading.
